# Appendix G: Solutions {#app-solutions}

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_solutions.py. Do not edit. -->

75 of the book's 202 exercises have a worked solution. Each is a program in the companion examples, beside the chapter's listings, under `examples/chNN/solutions/`, with its expected output in a `.out` file next to it. The solutions are not printed here: the listing harness compiles and runs every one of them on every target, exactly as it does the chapters' listings, so the files are the version that is known to work.

A solution is one way to do the exercise, not the only one. Several build on a chapter's own listings or modules and import them, and run from their `solutions/` directory. A solution marked *blocked* depends on a compiler fix that the toolchain this book is checked against does not have yet; its `.out` file is the result it gives once the fix is in.
